name: Skeleton
desc: A full-body anatomical skeleton rendered as an ivory danse-macabre engraving, bobbing and swinging its limbs as it jigs, does the Thriller shuffle, or rattles its chattering jaw by candle-glow.

hue.doc: bone tint / glow hue (42 = warm ivory; drives neon+xray color)

y.doc: anchor y as canvas fraction (feet on ground)

pose.doc: pose preset; auto = section-driven medley per act

style.doc: aesthetic: ivory ink-engraving / stark black-white print / glowing club outline / radiographic x-ray glow

act.doc: multi-minute pose dramaturgy used when pose=auto
